prompt: My sister and I ___ students.
explanation: İki kişiden söz eden özne (my sister and I = we) çoğuldur ve are alır: My sister and I are students.

prompt: We ___ in Paris last summer.
explanation: Geçmişte be fiili was/were olur: I/he/she/it → was, we/you/they → were. We were in Paris.

prompt: How old ___ your daughter? — She's six.
explanation: İngilizcede yaş have ile değil be ile söylenir: How old is she? She is six. Tekil özne (your daughter) is alır.

prompt: "Is your father at home?" "No, he ___."
explanation: Be ile sorulan soruya kısa cevapta be tekrar edilir: Is he…? → Yes, he is. / No, he isn't. Do/does burada kullanılmaz.

prompt: The children ___ (be) in the garden now.
explanation: Children (çocuklar) çoğuldur; şimdiki zamanda be fiili are olur: The children are in the garden.

prompt: It ___ (be) very hot yesterday.
explanation: Yesterday geçmişi gösterir; it ile be fiilinin geçmişi was'tır: It was very hot yesterday.

prompt: I have 25 years old.
explanation: Türkçedeki '25 yaşındayım' İngilizcede have ile değil be ile söylenir: I am 25 years old (ya da I am 25).

prompt: Tom ___ late for class.
explanation: Sıklık zarfları (never, always, usually) be fiilinden sonra, asıl fiilden önce gelir: Tom is never late. / Tom never comes late.

prompt: Does your mother ___ in an office?
explanation: Soruda does kullanıldığında asıl fiil -s almaz, yalın kalır: Does your mother work…?

prompt: I usually ___ to school, but today I'm taking the bus.
explanation: Alışkanlık (usually, every day) present simple ile söylenir: I usually walk. Bugüne özel geçici durum ise continuous: today I'm taking the bus.

prompt: Listen! Someone ___ at the door.
explanation: Listen!, Look! gibi uyarılar şu anda olan bir şeyi gösterir; bu yüzden present continuous kullanılır: Someone is knocking.

prompt: She ___ (watch) TV every evening.
explanation: He/she/it ile present simple'da fiil -s alır; -ch, -sh, -s, -x ile biten fiillere -es eklenir: watch → watches.

prompt: My father ___ (not / drink) coffee.
explanation: Present simple'da he/she/it ile olumsuz doesn't (does not) + yalın fiildir: My father doesn't drink coffee ('doesn't drinks' değil).

prompt: Does he likes chocolate?
explanation: Does zaten üçüncü tekil kişiyi gösterir; ardından gelen fiil -s almaz: Does he like chocolate?

prompt: My mother is a doctor. ___ works in a big hospital.
explanation: Türkçedeki 'o' İngilizcede kadın için she, erkek için he olur. Özne olduğu için she kullanılır (her nesne ya da iyelik içindir).

prompt: Is this ___ bag, or is it Ali's?
explanation: İsmin önünde iyelik sıfatı kullanılır: your bag. Yours ismin yerini tutar ve arkasından isim gelmez: This bag is yours.

prompt: These books aren't ours. They're ___.
explanation: Arkasından isim gelmeyen iyelik zamiri: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs. They're theirs = onlarınki.

prompt: Can you help ___? We are lost.
explanation: Fiilden sonra nesne zamiri gelir: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Help us (bize yardım et).

prompt: Ayşe has a new bike. ___ bike is red.
explanation: Sahip kadın olduğu için iyelik sıfatı her olur: her bike (onun bisikleti). Sahibine göre seçilir.

prompt: I love my parents, and I call ___ every day.
explanation: Fiilden sonra çoğul bir nesnenin yerini them tutar: I call them (onları ararım). They özne içindir.

prompt: My father is a teacher and her school is near our house.
explanation: İyelik sahibine göre seçilir: sahip erkek (father) olduğu için his school. Türkçede 'onun' tek olduğu için he/she karışabilir.

prompt: ___ a lot of people at the concert last night.
explanation: Geçmişte 'vardı' there was (tekil/sayılamayan) ve there were (çoğul) ile söylenir. People çoğuldur: There were.

prompt: "Is there a park near your house?" "Yes, ___."
explanation: Is there…? sorusuna kısa cevap there ile verilir: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. Soru tekil olduğu için is.

prompt: I ___ two brothers and a sister.
explanation: 'İki erkek kardeşim var' sahiplik bildirir; İngilizcede have ile söylenir: I have two brothers. There is/are bir yerde bir şeyin bulunduğunu söyler.

prompt: There ___ much traffic this morning.
explanation: Traffic sayılamayan bir isimdir; tekil gibi davranır: there isn't much traffic. Çoğul isimlerde there aren't.

prompt: ___ any good restaurants in this street?
explanation: Çoğul bir isim sorulurken Are there…? kullanılır: Are there any good restaurants? Tekilde Is there…?

prompt: There ___ (be) no shops in this village fifty years ago.
explanation: Ago geçmişi gösterir, shops çoğuldur: there were. Tekil olsaydı there was olurdu.

prompt: There is many cars in the street.
explanation: Çoğul isimle there are kullanılır: There are many cars. There is tekil ve sayılamayan isimler içindir.

prompt: Who are ___ people over there?
explanation: Uzaktaki (over there) çoğul şeyler için those kullanılır: those people. Yakın çoğul these, uzak tekil that.

prompt: "I passed my driving test!" "___'s fantastic!"
explanation: Az önce söylenen bir şeye karşılık verirken that kullanılır: That's great! That's fantastic!

prompt: I'm very busy ___ week.
explanation: Şimdiki zaman dilimi this ile söylenir: this week, this morning, this year. Week tekil olduğu için these olmaz.

prompt: Do you remember ___ day at the beach in 2015?
explanation: Geçmişte kalan bir zaman that ile gösterilir: that day, that summer. This şimdiki ya da yakın zamandır.

prompt: ___ apples in my bag are from our garden.
explanation: Yanımızdaki (in my bag) çoğul şeyler için these kullanılır: These apples are… Tekil olsaydı this apple.

prompt: Can you see ___ tall building over there?
explanation: Uzaktaki (over there) tekil bir şey için that kullanılır: that building. Çoğul olsaydı those buildings.

prompt: I don't like this shoes; they are too small.
explanation: İsim çoğulsa işaret sözcüğü de çoğul olur: these shoes. This yalnızca tekil isimle gelir.

prompt: ___ are you crying? — Because I'm sad.
explanation: Cevap because ile başlıyorsa soru why (neden) ile sorulmuştur: Why are you crying?

prompt: ___ bag is this? — It's Elif's.
explanation: Sahibini sormak için whose (kimin) kullanılır: Whose bag is this? Who's ise who is'in kısaltmasıdır.

prompt: Who ___ the window? — Ahmet did.
explanation: Who öznenin kendisini soruyorsa do/did kullanılmaz, fiil düz cümledeki gibi çekimlenir: Who broke the window?

prompt: ___ do you go to the gym? — Three times a week.
explanation: Sıklık (ne kadar sık) how often ile sorulur: How often do you go? — Three times a week. How long süreyi sorar.

prompt: Where ___ your sister work?
explanation: Present simple soruda he/she/it ile does kullanılır, asıl fiil yalın kalır: Where does your sister work?

prompt: What ___ you do last weekend?
explanation: Geçmişte soru did + özne + yalın fiil ile kurulur: What did you do last weekend?

prompt: Where does she lives?
explanation: Does kullanıldığında asıl fiil -s almaz: Where does she live? Üçüncü tekil bilgisini does taşır.

prompt: We usually go skiing ___ winter.
explanation: Mevsimler, aylar ve yıllarla in kullanılır: in winter, in June, in 2020.

prompt: I'll call you ___ Friday evening.
explanation: Günlerle on kullanılır; günün bir bölümü belli bir güne bağlanınca da on kalır: on Friday evening (ama in the evening).

prompt: Shops are closed ___ Christmas Day.
explanation: Belli bir gün ya da tarih on alır: on Christmas Day, on my birthday, on 5 May.

prompt: The train leaves ___ ten minutes. Hurry up!
explanation: Şu andan itibaren 'on dakika sonra' in ile söylenir: in ten minutes. After ten minutes bu anlamı vermez.

prompt: The film starts ___ half past eight.
explanation: Saatlerle at kullanılır: at half past eight, at 7 o'clock, at noon.

prompt: My grandfather was born ___ the 1950s.
explanation: Yıllar, on yıllar ve yüzyıllarla in kullanılır: in the 1950s, in 1998, in the 21st century.

prompt: We have English lessons in Tuesdays.
explanation: Haftanın günleriyle on kullanılır: on Tuesdays, on Monday. In aylar, yıllar ve mevsimler içindir.

prompt: Did you ___ your homework last night?
explanation: Did'den sonra asıl fiil yalın kalır, çünkü geçmiş bilgisini did taşır: Did you do…? ('Did you did' değil).

prompt: She ___ a new phone two days ago.
explanation: Buy düzensiz bir fiildir: buy → bought. Düzensiz fiillere -ed eklenmez. Ago geçmişi gösterir.

prompt: We ___ at home last weekend because it was raining.
explanation: Bitmiş bir zamanı gösteren last weekend ile past simple kullanılır: we stayed. Present perfect bu tür zaman ifadesiyle gelmez.

prompt: They ___ the bus this morning and were late for work.
explanation: Bu sabah olmuş ve bitmiş olay past simple ile söylenir: miss → missed (düzenli fiil, -ed).

prompt: He ___ (stop) the car and got out.
explanation: Tek heceli, ünlü + ünsüz ile biten fiillerde son ünsüz ikilenir: stop → stopped, plan → planned.

prompt: I ___ (not / see) Mehmet at the party yesterday.
explanation: Past simple'da olumsuz didn't (did not) + yalın fiil ile kurulur: I didn't see ('didn't saw' değil).

prompt: I was not go to work yesterday.
explanation: Asıl fiilin geçmiş olumsuzu was not ile değil did not ile kurulur: I did not (didn't) go to work yesterday.

prompt: This exam was ___ than the last one.
explanation: Ünsüz + y ile biten sıfatlarda y düşer, -ier eklenir: easy → easier, happy → happier. 'More easy' denmez.

prompt: That was the ___ day of my life.
explanation: Bad düzensizdir: bad → worse → the worst. Superlative (en kötü) the ile gelir: the worst day.

prompt: My house is ___ from the station than yours.
explanation: Far düzensizdir: far → further → the furthest (farther / the farthest da olur). Than varsa karşılaştırma (comparative) biçimi gerekir.

prompt: Ali is the oldest ___ the three brothers.
explanation: Superlative'de sayılan bir grubun içinden söz ederken of kullanılır: the oldest of the three. Yer ya da topluluk için in: the oldest in the class.

prompt: A taxi is ___ (expensive) than a bus.
explanation: İki ve daha çok heceli uzun sıfatlar more ile karşılaştırılır: expensive → more expensive than.

prompt: Is your English as good ___ your sister's?
explanation: Eşitlik as + sıfat + as ile söylenir: as good as. Than burada kullanılmaz.

prompt: This hotel is bigger from that one.
explanation: Comparative'den sonra than gelir: bigger than. Türkçedeki '-den daha' yüzünden from kullanmak sık bir hatadır.

prompt: I ___ TV when the doorbell rang.
explanation: Süren iş past continuous (was/were + -ing), onu kesen kısa olay past simple olur: I was watching TV when the doorbell rang.

prompt: While I was walking to work, I ___ an old friend.
explanation: Süren işin ortasında olan kısa olay past simple ile söylenir: While I was walking, I met an old friend.

prompt: She ___ the bus because she was talking on the phone.
explanation: Kaçırmak tek seferlik, kısa bir olaydır: she missed the bus. Süren arka plan (konuşma) past continuous kalır.

prompt: ___ it raining when you left the house?
explanation: Past continuous soruda was/were özneden önce gelir; it ile was: Was it raining…?

prompt: When the teacher came in, the students ___ talking immediately.
explanation: Biri olunca öbürünün başladığı art arda olaylar past simple ile söylenir: When the teacher came in, the students stopped talking.

prompt: My father ___ (drive) home when the accident happened.
explanation: Kaza olduğunda süren iş past continuous ile söylenir: my father was driving. Kesen olay (happened) past simple'dır.

prompt: We were having dinner when the lights suddenly ___ (go) out.
explanation: Süren işi (yemek) kesen ani olay past simple olur: the lights went out. Go düzensizdir: go → went.

prompt: When I arrived, they were eat dinner.
explanation: Past continuous was/were + fiil-ing ile kurulur: they were eating. Be'den sonra yalın fiil gelmez.

prompt: ___ you swim when you were five?
explanation: Geçmişteki genel yetenek could ile sorulur: Could you swim when you were five? Can şimdiki yetenek içindir.

prompt: I'm sorry, I ___ hear you. The music is too loud.
explanation: Can'in olumsuzu can't (cannot) olur; do ya da be ile olumsuz yapılmaz: I can't hear you.

prompt: I'd like ___ play the guitar.
explanation: Can'in mastar (to) biçimi yoktur; would like to, want to gibi yapılardan sonra to be able to kullanılır.

prompt: My little brother can ___ to ten in English.
explanation: Can'den sonra fiil yalın gelir, to ya da -s almaz: he can count.

prompt: The exam was difficult, but in the end I ___ pass it.
explanation: Geçmişte bir kez başarılan iş için olumlu cümlede could değil managed to / was able to kullanılır: I managed to pass it.

prompt: When I was a child, I ___ climb trees very fast.
explanation: Çocuklukta olan genel bir yetenek could ile söylenir: I could climb trees. Was able to da doğrudur.

prompt: I hope I'll ___ able to come to your wedding.
explanation: Can'in gelecek biçimi yoktur; will be able to kullanılır: I'll be able to come.

prompt: I will can help you tomorrow.
explanation: İki modal yan yana gelmez; gelecekte yetenek will be able to ile söylenir: I will be able to help you.

prompt: My sister ___ work on Saturdays. Her shop is open all weekend.
explanation: Have to çekimlenir: he/she/it ile has to olur: My sister has to work.

prompt: You ___ touch that. It's very hot!
explanation: Yapılmaması gereken şey (yasak, tehlike) mustn't ile söylenir. Don't have to 'gerek yok' demektir.

prompt: We ___ hurry. The train doesn't leave until ten.
explanation: Zorunluluk yoksa don't have to kullanılır: We don't have to hurry (acele etmemiz gerekmiyor). Mustn't yasak anlamı verir.

prompt: Will we ___ show our passports at the border?
explanation: Must'ın gelecek biçimi yoktur; will'den sonra have to kullanılır: Will we have to show our passports?

prompt: You must ___ your seat belt in the car.
explanation: Must'tan sonra fiil yalın gelir, to almaz: You must wear your seat belt.

prompt: Last night I ___ (have to) take a taxi because there were no buses.
explanation: Must'ın geçmişi yoktur; geçmişteki zorunluluk had to ile söylenir: I had to take a taxi.

prompt: ___ your brother have to wear a uniform at school?
explanation: Have to sorusu do/does ile kurulur; he/she ile does: Does your brother have to…?

prompt: She have to be at work at eight.
explanation: Have to üçüncü tekil kişide has to olur: She has to be at work at eight.

prompt: My keys are ___ my bag.
explanation: Bir şeyin içinde olan için in kullanılır: in my bag, in the box, in the kitchen.

prompt: She's ___ the train now; she'll arrive at six.
explanation: Otobüs, tren, uçak gibi toplu taşıma araçlarında on kullanılır: on the train, on the bus. Araba ve takside in: in a taxi.

prompt: He took his phone ___ his pocket.
explanation: Bir şeyin içinden dışarıya hareket out of ile söylenir: He took his phone out of his pocket.

prompt: We walked ___ the river for an hour.
explanation: Bir nehir, yol ya da sahil boyunca yürümek along ile söylenir. Across karşıya geçmek, through içinden geçmektir.

prompt: Our plane arrived ___ London at midnight.
explanation: Arrive to almaz: şehir ve ülkeyle arrive in, bina ya da nokta ile arrive at: arrive in London, arrive at the airport.

prompt: The supermarket is ___ to the bank.
explanation: 'Yanında' next to ile söylenir: The supermarket is next to the bank.

prompt: Walk ___ the bridge to get to the other side of the river.
explanation: Bir yandan öbür yana geçmek across ile söylenir: walk across the bridge. Köprü üzerinden geçerken over da olur.

prompt: We arrived to the hotel very late.
explanation: Arrive fiili to almaz; bina ya da belli bir nokta için arrive at kullanılır: We arrived at the hotel.

prompt: If you heat water to 100 degrees, it ___.
explanation: Her zaman doğru olan bilimsel gerçekler için iki tarafta da present simple kullanılır (sıfırıncı koşul): If you heat water, it boils.

prompt: If I ___ his phone number, I would call him.
explanation: Şimdiki gerçek dışı durum (numarasını bilmiyorum) ikinci koşulla söylenir: If + past simple, would + yalın fiil: If I knew…

prompt: If you don't leave now, you ___ the train.
explanation: Gerçekleşmesi olası bir durumun sonucu birinci koşulla söylenir: If + present simple, will + yalın fiil: you will miss the train.

prompt: I won't go to the party ___ you come with me.
explanation: Unless 'eğer … -mezse' demektir ve arkasından olumlu fiil gelir: I won't go unless you come (sen gelmezsen gitmem).

prompt: If she lived closer, we ___ each other more often.
explanation: If'li bölümde past simple (lived) varsa sonuç would + yalın fiil olur: we would see each other more often.

prompt: If it ___ (snow) tomorrow, the schools will close.
explanation: Birinci koşulda if'li bölüm, anlam gelecek olsa da present simple olur: If it snows tomorrow… ('If it will snow' değil).

prompt: If I ___ (be) taller, I would play basketball.
explanation: İkinci koşulda be fiili bütün kişilerde were olabilir: If I were taller… Gündelik dilde was de kullanılır.

prompt: If I had a car, I will drive to work.
explanation: If'li bölüm past simple (had) ise sonuç bölümü would ile kurulur: If I had a car, I would drive to work.

prompt: There ___ a cinema here, but now it's a supermarket.
explanation: Geçmişte olup artık olmayan durum used to + yalın fiil ile söylenir: There used to be a cinema here. Would durumlar için kullanılmaz.

prompt: I ___ have long hair when I was at university.
explanation: Have, be, live gibi durum fiilleriyle geçmiş alışkanlık would ile değil used to ile söylenir: I used to have long hair.

prompt: Don't worry, you'll soon get used to ___ in English.
explanation: Get used to (alışmak) ve be used to (alışkın olmak) yapısındaki to bir edattır; arkasından isim ya da -ing gelir: get used to working.

prompt: My grandfather ___ smoke, but he gave up years ago.
explanation: Olumlu cümlede geçmişteki, artık sürmeyen alışkanlık used to + yalın fiil ile söylenir: He used to smoke.

prompt: I often work late now; I ___ it.
explanation: Şimdi alışkın olduğumuz şey be used to + isim/zamir ile söylenir: I'm used to it. Used to tek başına geçmişi anlatır.

prompt: Where ___ you use to live before you moved here?
explanation: Used to'nun sorusu did ile kurulur ve used to → use to olur: Where did you use to live?

prompt: It took her a long time to get used to ___ (wake) up at five.
explanation: Get used to'daki to edattır; ardından fiil -ing alır: get used to waking up.

prompt: Did you used to play football at school?
explanation: Did'li soru ve olumsuzda geçmiş bilgisini did taşır, used to → use to olur: Did you use to play football?

prompt: When I got to the party, Mehmet ___ home. I didn't see him.
explanation: Ben gelmeden önce olmuş iş past perfect (had + V3) ile söylenir: Mehmet had gone home. Go'nun V3'ü gone'dır.

prompt: I didn't recognise her because she ___ her hair.
explanation: Tanımamadan önce olmuş değişiklik past perfect ile söylenir: she had cut her hair. Cut düzensizdir: cut → cut → cut.

prompt: She ___ never flown before, so she was very nervous.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir ana (gergin olduğu an) kadar hiç yaşanmamış deneyim had never + V3 ile söylenir: She had never flown before.

prompt: After he ___ dinner, he went for a walk.
explanation: Yürüyüşten önce biten iş past perfect ile söylenebilir: After he had eaten… Had'den sonra V3 gelir (eaten), V2 (ate) değil.

prompt: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.
explanation: Polis gelene kadar çoktan olmuş iş past perfect ile söylenir: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.

prompt: We were late. When we arrived, the meeting ___ (already / start).
explanation: Geldiğimizde toplantı çoktan başlamıştı: had already started. Already, had ile V3'ün arasına girer.

prompt: I ___ (not / see) the film before, so I enjoyed it a lot.
explanation: Past perfect'in olumsuzu hadn't (had not) + V3 ile kurulur: I hadn't seen the film before.

prompt: When I got home, I realised I had forget my wallet at the office.
explanation: Past perfect had + past participle (V3) ile kurulur: forget → forgot → forgotten: I had forgotten my wallet.

prompt: It's a lovely day, ___?
explanation: Olumlu cümleye olumsuz tag gelir ve cümledeki yardımcı fiil (is) tekrar edilir: It's a lovely day, isn't it?

prompt: You can swim, ___?
explanation: Tag cümledeki yardımcı fiili tekrar eder; can varsa do kullanılmaz: You can swim, can't you?

prompt: They didn't call you, ___?
explanation: Olumsuz cümleye olumlu tag gelir; past simple'da did: They didn't call you, did they?

prompt: Your sister has finished school, ___?
explanation: Present perfect'teki yardımcı fiil has'tir; tag'de o tekrar edilir: Your sister has finished school, hasn't she?

prompt: Nobody saw the accident, ___?
explanation: Nobody olumsuz anlamlıdır, tag olumlu olur; nobody/somebody için tag'de they kullanılır: Nobody saw it, did they?

prompt: You'll help me tomorrow, ___ you?
explanation: Olumlu cümlede will varsa tag won't olur: You'll help me tomorrow, won't you?

prompt: Ali was at the meeting, ___ he?
explanation: Cümledeki be fiili was olduğu için tag wasn't olur; isim yerine zamir (he) kullanılır: Ali was at the meeting, wasn't he?

prompt: She is your cousin, isn't it?
explanation: Tag'deki zamir cümlenin öznesine uyar: she → isn't she? Türkçedeki tek 'değil mi?' yüzünden her yerde 'isn't it' demek yanlıştır.

prompt: If you ___ me, I would have picked you up from the airport.
explanation: Geçmişteki gerçek dışı koşul üçüncü koşulla söylenir: If + past perfect (had called), would have + V3.

prompt: If we had booked earlier, we ___ less for the tickets last month.
explanation: Geçmişe dair hayalî sonuç would have + V3 ile söylenir: we would have paid less. Last month sonucun da geçmişte olduğunu gösterir.

prompt: I wish I ___ speak French. It would be so useful.
explanation: Şimdiki bir yetenek eksikliğinden yakınırken wish + could kullanılır: I wish I could speak French (keşke konuşabilsem).

prompt: If only I ___ to your advice last year!
explanation: Geçmişteki pişmanlık if only / wish + past perfect ile söylenir: If only I had listened to your advice!

prompt: I wish my neighbours ___ so much noise every night.
explanation: Başkasının sürekli davranışından yakınırken wish + would kullanılır: I wish they wouldn't make so much noise.

prompt: If he had driven more carefully, he ___ (not / have) the accident.
explanation: Üçüncü koşulun sonuç bölümü would have + V3'tür; olumsuzu wouldn't have had (have'in V3'ü had).

prompt: I wish I ___ (be) taller.
explanation: Şimdiki durumdan yakınırken wish + past kullanılır; be için were (gündelikte was): I wish I were taller.

prompt: If she had studied harder, she would have pass the exam.
explanation: Would have'den sonra past participle (V3) gelir: she would have passed the exam.

prompt: Please return the book ___ Monday at the latest.
explanation: By 'en geç … -e kadar' demektir: by Monday. Until bir işin o ana kadar sürdüğünü anlatır: I'll wait until Monday.

prompt: Don't call me at nine; I ___ my children to bed.
explanation: Gelecekte belli bir anda (saat dokuzda) sürecek iş future continuous ile söylenir: I'll be putting my children to bed.

prompt: By the time you wake up, I ___ for Ankara.
hint: by the time → will have + V3
explanation: Gelecekteki bir andan önce bitmiş olacak iş future perfect ile söylenir: By the time you wake up, I will have left.

prompt: This time next year, she ___ at university in Germany.
explanation: This time next year (gelecek yıl bu zamanlar) sürüyor olacak iş future continuous ile söylenir: she will be studying.

prompt: By the end of the month, we ___ all the money we need.
explanation: By the end of the month gelecekteki bir son noktadır; o ana kadar bitmiş olacak iş will have + V3 ile söylenir.

prompt: By 2030, she ___ (finish) her medical training.
explanation: By 2030'a kadar tamamlanmış olacak iş future perfect ile söylenir: she will have finished.

prompt: At 8 pm tomorrow, I ___ (fly) over the Atlantic.
explanation: Gelecekte belli bir saatte süren iş future continuous ile söylenir: I will be flying over the Atlantic.

prompt: By Friday, they will have build the new bridge.
explanation: Future perfect will have + past participle ile kurulur: build → built → built: they will have built the bridge.

prompt: Where do you usually ___ your car washed?
explanation: Bir işi başkasına yaptırmak have/get + nesne + V3 ile söylenir: get your car washed. Make ve do bu yapıda kullanılmaz.

prompt: She had her nails ___ at a salon.
explanation: Have something done yapısında nesneden sonra V3 gelir: She had her nails done (tırnaklarını yaptırdı).

prompt: We're having our roof ___ next month.
explanation: Have her zamanda çekimlenir, nesneden sonra V3 kalır: We're having our roof repaired.

prompt: I had the waiter ___ us a new table.
explanation: Bir kişiye iş yaptırırken have + kişi + yalın fiil kullanılır, to yoktur: I had the waiter bring us a table.

prompt: He had his car ___ while he was on holiday.
explanation: İstemeden başa gelen kötü olay da have + nesne + V3 ile söylenir: He had his car broken into (arabası soyuldu).

prompt: My sister ___ her wedding dress made by a famous designer last year.
explanation: Geçmişte yaptırılan iş had/got + nesne + V3 ile söylenir: She had her wedding dress made.

prompt: I couldn't fix the computer myself, so I got my neighbour ___ (look) at it.
explanation: Birine bir iş yaptırmak get + kişi + to + fiil ile söylenir: I got my neighbour to look at it.

prompt: I got my brother fix my bike.
explanation: Get ile birine iş yaptırırken fiilden önce to gelir: I got my brother to fix my bike. (Have ile to yok: I had my brother fix it.)

prompt: Two ___ came to fix the heating.
explanation: Man düzensiz bir çoğul alır: man → men. Sayıdan sonra isim çoğul olur: two men.

prompt: How ___ people were at the wedding?
explanation: People sayılabilir çoğul bir isimdir; sayı how many ile sorulur. How much sayılamayanlar içindir.

prompt: There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
explanation: Water sayılamayan bir isimdir; olumsuz cümlede much ile kullanılır: There isn't much water.

prompt: I have ___ questions. Do you have a minute?
explanation: 'Birkaç' anlamı sayılabilir isimle a few ile verilir: a few questions. A little sayılamayanlar içindir.

prompt: We need some new ___ for the living room.
explanation: Furniture (mobilya) sayılamayan bir isimdir: çoğul olmaz, a/an almaz: some new furniture.

prompt: My baby already has two ___ (tooth).
explanation: Tooth düzensiz çoğul alır: tooth → teeth (foot → feet gibi).

prompt: Many ___ (city) in Turkey have a long history.
explanation: Ünsüz + y ile biten isimlerde y düşer, -ies eklenir: city → cities, country → countries.

prompt: The news are very good today.
explanation: News sonu -s ile bitse de sayılamayan, tekil bir isimdir: The news is very good.

prompt: "I'm cold." "Oh, wait. I ___ the window."
explanation: Konuşurken o anda verilen karar ve teklif will + yalın fiil ile söylenir: I'll close the window.

prompt: We've already decided: we ___ a new car next year.
explanation: Önceden verilmiş karar ve plan be going to + yalın fiil ile söylenir: We are going to buy a new car.

prompt: I think it ___ sunny tomorrow.
explanation: Kişisel tahmin (I think, probably) çoğunlukla will ile söylenir: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.

prompt: I'll phone you before I ___ the office.
explanation: Before, when, after gibi zaman bağlaçlarından sonra anlam gelecek olsa da present simple gelir: before I leave.

prompt: Will you ___ me with my bags?
explanation: Will'den sonra fiil yalın gelir, to almaz: Will you help me?

prompt: I've got the tickets! We ___ (see) the concert on Saturday.
explanation: Önceden ayarlanmış plan be going to ya da present continuous ile söylenir: We are going to see / We are seeing the concert.

prompt: Be careful! You ___ (drop) those glasses!
explanation: Şu an görülen bir kanıta dayanan tahmin be going to ile söylenir: You're going to drop those glasses!

prompt: I promise I won't forgetting your birthday.
explanation: Will/won't'tan sonra fiil yalın gelir: I won't forget your birthday.

prompt: Be quiet, please. I ___ on the phone.
explanation: Şu anda süren iş am/is/are + -ing ile söylenir: I am talking on the phone.

prompt: She usually wears jeans, but today she ___ a dress.
explanation: Bugüne özel geçici durum present continuous ile söylenir: today she is wearing a dress. Alışkanlık (usually) present simple'dır.

prompt: I ___ a glass of water, please.
explanation: Want, know, like, need gibi durum fiilleri genellikle -ing almaz: I want a glass of water.

prompt: What ___ she doing in the kitchen?
explanation: Present continuous soruda be özneden önce gelir; she ile is: What is she doing?

prompt: We ___ a great time here in Antalya!
explanation: Have 'sahip olmak' anlamında -ing almaz ama 'yaşamak, geçirmek' anlamında alır: We are having a great time.

prompt: Why are you ___ (sit) on the floor?
explanation: Tek heceli, ünlü + ünsüz ile biten fiillerde -ing'den önce son ünsüz ikilenir: sit → sitting, run → running.

prompt: I ___ (not / work) today. It's a holiday.
explanation: Present continuous'un olumsuzu am not / isn't / aren't + -ing ile kurulur: I'm not working today.

prompt: Look! The cat is lieing on the sofa.
explanation: -ie ile biten fiillerde -ing'den önce ie → y olur: lie → lying, die → dying.

prompt: Don't phone at eight tonight; we ___ dinner.
explanation: Gelecekte belli bir anda (bu akşam sekizde) sürecek iş future continuous ile söylenir: we'll be having dinner.

prompt: This time next month, I ___ in my new flat.
explanation: This time next month (gelecek ay bu zamanlar) sürüyor olacak durum will be + -ing ile söylenir.

prompt: ___ you be passing the post office today? I need some stamps.
explanation: Birinin planını kibarca sorup bir şey istemek için Will you be + -ing kullanılır: Will you be passing the post office?

prompt: At midnight tonight, most people in the town ___.
explanation: Gece yarısı gibi belli bir anda süren durum future continuous ile söylenir: most people will be sleeping.

prompt: Tomorrow at 3 pm, I ___ an exam, so I can't answer my phone.
explanation: Future continuous will be + fiil-ing ile kurulur; be ve -ing ikisi de gerekir: I will be taking an exam.

prompt: This time on Saturday, we ___ (drive) to the coast.
explanation: Cumartesi bu saatte sürüyor olacak iş future continuous ile söylenir: we will be driving.

prompt: We ___ (not / use) the car this evening, so you can borrow it.
explanation: Future continuous'un olumsuzu won't (will not) be + -ing'dir: We won't be using the car.

prompt: At eight o'clock tomorrow, I will working at the hospital.
explanation: Will'den sonra be gelmeden -ing kullanılmaz: I will be working at the hospital.

prompt: His hands were dirty because he ___ in the garden.
explanation: Geçmişte görülen bir sonucun (kirli eller) nedeni olan süreç past perfect continuous ile söylenir: he had been working.

prompt: We ___ for two hours when we finally found a petrol station.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir ana kadar süren iş ve süresi (for two hours) had been + -ing ile söylenir.

prompt: By the time she retired, she ___ three hundred paintings.
explanation: Bitmiş işin miktarı (üç yüz tablo) past perfect simple ile söylenir: she had painted three hundred paintings. Continuous süreci anlatır.

prompt: How long ___ she been living there before she moved?
explanation: Past perfect continuous sorusu had + özne + been + -ing ile kurulur: How long had she been living there?

prompt: I ___ that car for twenty years when it finally broke down.
explanation: Own, know, have (sahip olmak) gibi durum fiilleri continuous olmaz: I had owned that car for twenty years.

prompt: She was out of breath because she ___ (run).
explanation: Nefes nefese olmasının nedeni olan süreç past perfect continuous ile söylenir: she had been running.

prompt: When I met him, he ___ (work) at the bank for six months.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir ana kadar süren iş had been + -ing ile söylenir: he had been working there for six months (had worked da olur).

prompt: I was tired because I had been study all day.
explanation: Past perfect continuous had been + fiil-ing ile kurulur: I had been studying all day.

prompt: I'd rather walk ___ take a taxi.
explanation: İki seçenek karşılaştırılırken would rather A than B kullanılır, iki fiil de yalındır: I'd rather walk than take a taxi.

prompt: Would you ___ go to the cinema or stay at home?
explanation: Arkasından yalın fiil (go) geldiği için would rather kullanılır. Would prefer'den sonra to gelir: Would you prefer to go…?

prompt: I'd prefer ___ alone, if you don't mind.
explanation: Tek bir durumdaki tercih would prefer + to + fiil ile söylenir: I'd prefer to travel alone.

prompt: You'd better ___ late for the interview.
explanation: Had better'ın olumsuzu had better not + yalın fiildir: You'd better not be late. To ve do kullanılmaz.

prompt: My parents would rather I ___ closer to them.
explanation: Başkasının bir şey yapmasını tercih ederken would rather + özne + past simple kullanılır; anlam şimdi ya da gelecektir.

prompt: She prefers swimming ___ running.
explanation: Genel tercih prefer A to B ile söylenir: She prefers swimming to running. Than kullanılmaz.

prompt: It's very late. We'd better ___ (go) home.
explanation: Had better'dan sonra yalın fiil gelir, to almaz: We'd better go home.

prompt: I prefer tea than coffee in the morning.
explanation: Prefer ile karşılaştırma to ile yapılır: I prefer tea to coffee. Than would rather ile kullanılır.

prompt: It was ___ a long journey that we were exhausted.
explanation: Arkasında a + sıfat + isim olduğu için such kullanılır: such a long journey. So yalnızca sıfat ya da zarfın önüne gelir.

prompt: The coffee was ___ hot that I couldn't drink it.
explanation: Arkasında isim olmayan sıfatın önüne so gelir: so hot that… Such ise isimli öbeklerle kullanılır.

prompt: I ___ want to come, but I have to work.
explanation: Olumlu cümlede bir şeyi vurgulamak için do + yalın fiil kullanılır: I do want to come (gerçekten gelmek istiyorum).

prompt: There were ___ few people at the meeting that it was cancelled.
explanation: Miktar sözcükleri (many, much, few, little) so ile vurgulanır: so few people that…

prompt: They have ___ good food at that restaurant.
explanation: Sıfat + sayılamayan isim önünde such kullanılır, a almaz: such good food.

prompt: We had ___ fun at the party that we didn't want to leave.
explanation: Fun sayılamayan bir isimdir; miktarı vurgulamak için so much kullanılır: so much fun that…

prompt: "Have some more cake." "No, thanks. But it ___ look delicious."
explanation: Vurgulu do özneye göre çekimlenir; it ile does, ardından yalın fiil gelir: it does look delicious.

prompt: She did called you, but you didn't answer.
explanation: Vurgulu did'den sonra fiil yalın kalır: She did call you.

prompt: "I'm really hungry." "So ___ I."
explanation: Olumlu cümleye katılırken önceki cümledeki yardımcı fiil tekrar edilir; be varsa: So am I.

prompt: "I haven't finished my homework." "I haven't ___."
explanation: Olumsuz bir cümleye olumsuz cümleyle katılırken sona either gelir: I haven't either (= Neither have I). Too olumlu içindir.

prompt: "Is it going to rain today?" "I'm afraid ___. Look at those dark clouds."
explanation: Be afraid, think, hope ile so bütün bir cümlenin yerini tutar: I'm afraid so (maalesef evet). Olumsuzu I'm afraid not.

prompt: My sister doesn't like coffee, but I ___.
explanation: Katılmazken asıl fiil tekrar edilmez, yardımcı fiil kullanılır; present simple'da do: but I do.

prompt: These shoes are too small. Do you have bigger ___?
explanation: Tekrarlanan sayılabilir ismin yerini tekilde one, çoğulda ones tutar: bigger ones (shoes).

prompt: "Did you lock the door?" "I think ___, but I'll check."
explanation: Think, hope, expect ile so bütün bir cümlenin yerine geçer: I think so (sanırım evet).

prompt: "I didn't understand the question." "___ did I."
explanation: Olumsuz bir cümleye katılırken Neither/Nor + yardımcı fiil + özne kullanılır: Neither did I.

prompt: "I'm not tired." "Neither do I."
explanation: Neither'dan sonraki yardımcı fiil önceki cümleye uyar: I'm not tired → Neither am I. Do, present simple'lı cümleler içindir.

prompt: This jacket looks nice. Can I try ___?
explanation: Ayrılabilen phrasal verb'lerde nesne zamirse ortaya girer: try it on ('try on it' değil).

prompt: My car ___ on the motorway, so I called a mechanic.
explanation: Break down 'bozulmak, arızalanmak' demektir: My car broke down. Break up ayrılmak, break out (savaş, yangın) çıkmaktır.

prompt: I need to ___ what time the museum opens.
explanation: Bir bilgiyi araştırıp öğrenmek find out ile söylenir: find out what time it opens. Find tek başına bir şeyi bulmaktır.

prompt: She finally ___ smoking last year.
explanation: Give up 'bir alışkanlığı bırakmak' demektir: She gave up smoking. Give in pes etmek, give away bağışlamaktır.

prompt: I'll ___ at your hotel at eight and we can drive to the airport.
explanation: Birini arabayla almak pick up ile söylenir; zamir ortaya girer ve up düşmez: I'll pick you up.

prompt: If you don't know the word, look it ___ in the dictionary.
explanation: Sözlükte ya da listede bakmak look up ile söylenir; zamir ortaya girer: look it up.

prompt: Do you get ___ with your new colleagues?
explanation: Biriyle iyi geçinmek get on with ile söylenir (Amerikan İngilizcesinde get along with): Do you get on with them?

prompt: My grandmother looks before the children when I'm at work.
explanation: Birine bakmak, ilgilenmek look after ile söylenir: My grandmother looks after the children.

prompt: I ___ buy you a present, but the shop was closed.
explanation: Geçmişteki ama gerçekleşmemiş niyet was/were going to ile söylenir: I was going to buy you a present, but…

prompt: We were about to ___ when the phone rang.
explanation: Was/were about to 'tam … -mek üzereydi' demektir; ardından yalın fiil gelir: We were about to leave.

prompt: He promised that he ___ never be late again.
explanation: Geçmişte verilen sözü aktarırken will → would olur: He promised that he would never be late again.

prompt: The concert ___ start at eight, but the singer was late.
explanation: Ayarlanmış ama gerçekleşmemiş plan was supposed to + yalın fiil ile söylenir: The concert was supposed to start at eight.

prompt: I couldn't go out last night because I ___ my aunt at the airport at ten.
explanation: Geçmişte önceden ayarlanmış bir randevu past continuous ile söylenir: I was meeting my aunt at ten.

prompt: Sorry, I ___ (be going to / call) you yesterday, but I forgot.
explanation: Türkçedeki '-ecektim ama' yapısı was going to ile söylenir: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

prompt: In 2010, nobody knew that the small team ___ (win) the league five years later.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir andan bakınca gelecekte olacak olan would ile söylenir: nobody knew the team would win.

prompt: We were about to leaving when it started to snow.
explanation: About to'dan sonra fiil yalın gelir, -ing almaz: We were about to leave.

prompt: In July, my parents ___ in this house for forty years.
explanation: Gelecekteki bir noktaya (In July) kadar sürecek işin süresi will have been + -ing ile söylenir.

prompt: By the end of the marathon, they ___ for over four hours.
explanation: Gelecekteki bir ana kadar geçecek süre (for over four hours) future perfect continuous ile vurgulanır.

prompt: By 2030, the company ___ 10,000 cars.
explanation: Miktar (10.000 araba) söylenirken future perfect simple kullanılır: will have produced. Continuous süre içindir.

prompt: Don't expect much energy from Ali when he lands; he ___ for fourteen hours.
explanation: Bir an için güçlü bir tahmin yaparken de future perfect continuous kullanılır: he will have been flying for fourteen hours.

prompt: By the time the bus ___, we'll have been waiting for an hour.
explanation: By the time'dan sonra anlam gelecek olsa da present simple gelir: By the time the bus comes…

prompt: By next spring, I ___ (learn) English for ten years.
explanation: Gelecekteki bir noktaya kadar süren iş for ile birlikte will have been + -ing ile söylenir: I will have been learning English for ten years.

prompt: By the time she retires, Dr Demir ___ (work) at this hospital for 35 years.
explanation: Emekli olacağı ana kadar geçecek süre future perfect continuous ile söylenir: she will have been working for 35 years.

prompt: By midnight, the firefighters will have be fighting the fire for twelve hours.
explanation: Future perfect continuous will have been + -ing ile kurulur; have'den sonra be değil been gelir.

prompt: It's late. It's time ___ to bed.
explanation: It's time + özne + past simple, çoktan yapılması gereken işi anlatır: It's time we went to bed. (Ya da It's time to go to bed.)

prompt: He talks as if he ___ everything, but he doesn't.
explanation: Gerçek olmayan bir durumu as if + past simple anlatır: He talks as if he knew everything (aslında bilmiyor).

prompt: She looked at me as if I ___ something terrible.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir an için gerçek dışı durum as if + past perfect ile söylenir: as if I had done something terrible.

prompt: It looks as if it ___ going to rain. Take an umbrella.
explanation: Gerçek olması muhtemel bir izlenim as if + present ile söylenir: It looks as if it is going to rain.

prompt: ___ you could live anywhere in the world, where would you go?
explanation: Suppose / supposing / what if + past simple hayalî bir durum kurar: Suppose you could live anywhere…

prompt: It's high time the council ___ (repair) this road.
explanation: It's high time + özne + past simple, gecikmiş bir işi vurgular: It's high time the council repaired this road.

prompt: He acts as though he ___ (be) the manager, but he's only an intern.
explanation: Gerçek dışı durumda be fiili resmî dilde were (gündelikte was) olur: as though he were the manager.

prompt: It's about time you start looking for a job.
explanation: It's about time + özne'den sonra fiil past simple olur: It's about time you started looking for a job.

prompt: Students ___ the exam must turn off their phones.
explanation: Kısaltılmış ilgi cümlesinde etken anlam -ing ile verilir: students (who are) taking the exam.

prompt: The report ___ last week contains several errors.
explanation: Edilgen anlamlı kısaltılmış ilgi cümlesi V3 ile kurulur: the report (which was) published last week.

prompt: The ___ of the new bridge took four years.
explanation: The … of yapısında isim gerekir: construct → construction (yapım). Fiil ya da sıfat bu yere girmez.

prompt: Nobody has explained the reason ___ the delay.
explanation: Reason ismi for edatıyla kullanılır: the reason for the delay ('reason of' değil).

prompt: There are only two tickets ___ for tonight's show.
explanation: Available gibi bazı sıfatlar ismin arkasına gelebilir; sıfatlar çoğul olmaz: two tickets available.

prompt: The ___ (fail) of the project cost the company millions.
explanation: The … of yapısında isim gerekir: fail (başarısız olmak) → failure (başarısızlık).

prompt: There has been a 10% increase ___ the price of bread.
explanation: Bir şeydeki artış increase in ile söylenir: an increase in the price. Of yalnızca miktar içindir: an increase of 10%.

prompt: The paintings stealing from the museum have never been found.
explanation: Tablolar çalınmıştır (edilgen); kısaltılmış ilgi cümlesi V3 ile kurulur: the paintings stolen from the museum.

prompt: (Formal letter) I would be grateful if you ___ send me further information.
explanation: Resmî rica kalıbı: I would be grateful if you could… Can bu kalıpta yanlıştır, gonna ise yalnızca gündelik konuşmada kullanılır.

prompt: (Formal report) The company ___ its prices by 5% last year.
explanation: Resmî yazıda tek sözcüklü fiiller tercih edilir: increase. Hike up, bump up gündelik dildir.

prompt: (Formal email) ___ your request, we will reply within five working days.
explanation: Resmî yazıda bir konuya değinirken regarding (ile ilgili olarak) kullanılır; gündelik karşılığı about'tur.

prompt: (Formal) ___ did you address the letter?
explanation: Resmî dilde edat soru sözcüğünün önüne alınır ve whom olur: To whom did you address the letter? Gündelik: Who did you send it to?

prompt: (Job application) I ___ like to apply for the position of sales manager.
explanation: Kibar ve resmî istek would like to ile söylenir; resmî yazıda kısaltma da kullanılmaz: I would like to apply.

prompt: (Formal letter) We regret to ___ you that the event has been cancelled.
explanation: Resmî kötü haber kalıbı: We regret to inform you that… (üzülerek bildiririz ki).

prompt: (Formal notice) Applicants ___ required to send a CV and two references.
explanation: Resmî duyurularda edilgen yapı sıktır: Applicants are required to… (adayların … göndermesi gerekmektedir).

prompt: (Formal letter) We apologise for the delay and will send the stuff you ordered tomorrow.
explanation: Stuff gündelik bir sözcüktür, resmî yazıda kullanılmaz; yerine items, goods ya da documents gibi açık bir isim gelir.

prompt: She went to work ___ having a high fever.
explanation: Ardından isim ya da -ing gelen zıtlık bağlacı in spite of / despite'tır: in spite of having a fever. Although ardından tam cümle ister.

prompt: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully.
explanation: As long as 'şartıyla, -dikçe' demektir: You can borrow it as long as you drive carefully. Unless 'eğer … -mezse' anlamı verir.

prompt: The flight was delayed ___ the storm.
explanation: Ardından isim (the storm) gelen neden bağlacı due to / because of'tur. Because ardından tam cümle ister: because there was a storm.

prompt:
Nobody told me about the meeting.
I ___ about the meeting.
explanation: Etken cümle (Nobody told me) edilgene çevrilir: I wasn't told about the meeting. Nobody olumsuzluğu fiile geçer.

prompt:
It's not necessary for you to bring food.
You ___ bring food.
explanation: « It's not necessary » = « you don't have to »: gereklilik yoksa don't have to kullanılır (mustn't yasak anlamı verir).

prompt:
I last went to the cinema in March.
I ___ to the cinema since March.
explanation: « I last went … in March » = « I haven't been … since March »: son kez yapılan iş, o tarihten beri yapılmayan iş olarak present perfect ile söylenir.

prompt:
The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
It was ___ film that I fell asleep.
explanation: So + sıfat that … = such + a + sıfat + isim that …: It was such a boring film that I fell asleep.

prompt:
'I'll call you tomorrow,' she said to me.
She told me ___ me the next day.
explanation: Dolaylı anlatımda will → would ve tomorrow → the next day olur: She told me she would call me the next day.

prompt:
Somebody stole my bike last night.
I ___ last night.
explanation: Başa gelen kötü olay have + nesne + V3 ile söylenir: I had my bike stolen last night.

prompt:
You should see a doctor.
If I ___ see a doctor.
explanation: Öğüt vermenin bir yolu ikinci koşuldur: You should … = If I were you, I would …

prompt:
It was a mistake to sell the house.
We ___ the house.
